# Brief 09: Digital roadmap

Audience: Fairhaven Water executive team.
Decision: approve a three-year, $64M digital programme and the first-year portfolio.
Format: 9 slides, density balanced. Start with a cover and end with next steps.
Data: data.csv holds the initiative list with value, cost and duration used on slides 4 and 5.

## Facts

F1: 34% of Fairhaven customers use self-service channels; the target for 2028 is 70% and the utility peer median is 52%.
F2: The contact centre handles 2.1M calls a year at $6.40 a call, a cost of $13.4M.
F3: The roadmap has eight initiatives worth $38M of annual benefit by 2028 for $64M of investment over three years.
F4: Investment phasing (USD million): 2026 21, 2027 27, 2028 16.
F5: Initiative value, cost and duration: smart meters 12.0, 22, 30 months; leak analytics 7.5, 9, 14; self-service app 6.0, 8, 12; billing platform 4.5, 10, 24; field mobile 3.2, 4, 9; chatbot 2.4, 2, 6; data platform 1.4, 6, 12; asset twin 1.0, 3, 10 (value USD million a year, cost USD million, months).
F6: Leak analytics could cut non-revenue water from 21% to 17% of supply.
F7: Only 3 of 8 initiatives depend on the data platform, but it unblocks $24M of the $38M benefit.
F8: Delivery capacity: the digital team has 46 people and needs 70 at peak in 2027.
F9: Customer app ratings are 3.1 out of 5 today; the target is 4.2.
F10: First-year portfolio: data platform, self-service app, chatbot, leak analytics and field mobile, costing $21M in 2026.
